contents.text: The docs don't mention Unity, so I'm checking the closest match, the HTTP API with SSE sessions in LouisAgent.Api.md. Unity could plausibly call that over HTTP, but the docs don't cover it, so I can't confirm it. I'll offer the user some options.

No, the docs don't mention a Unity plugin, and the framework doesn't list one among its hosts.

The closest thing is the HTTP API. Its sessions endpoints take a message as a turn streamed back as server-sent events. The docs don't say anything about Unity clients, so whether a game can use it that way is something you'd need to test yourself.

`src/docs/projects/LouisAgent.Api.md`

choices.label: Show me the HTTP API
choices.why: The sessions endpoints and how a turn streams back.

choices.label: Show me the hosts
choices.why: The terminal, Rider, HTTP API and MCP server, side by side.

choices.label: Ask about another engine
choices.why: Tell me the engine or platform you have in mind, and I'll check the docs for it.
